subject: Important Update: Changes to our Billing System
body: Dear valued customers, we wanted to inform you about some upcoming changes to our billing system. In an effort to improve efficiency and accuracy, we will be transitioning to a new billing platform starting next month. This change should not impact your current billing cycle, but we recommend reviewing your account details to ensure everything is up to date. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to our customer support team. Thank you for your understanding and continued support.
